answer: Require each agent to post a refundable stake bond that is slashed on proven fraud before it can earn or transact. One identity costs little, but a Sybil attacker must fund a separate bond for every fake agent, so ten thousand identities cost ten thousand bonds and lock real capital that cannot be spent elsewhere. Each identity is an island that must be funded separately; like a comet that burns on entry, each fake burns capital, and even a walnut-sized bond per identity makes mass forgery expensive, while honest agents recover theirs.
